port.spotlight.aiLocal: Nothing is sent until you press Enter.
port.shelf.drop: Drop files here to keep them for later
port.camera.hint: Check the camera in your system settings
port.translate.noOllama: Ollama is not running. Start it or choose another engine in Settings.
port.settings.aboutText: A Rust port for Windows, Linux and macOS of V-Notch by w0otdev and David Leitner, under the Apache License 2.0.
port.settings.slimIdle: Slim notch when nothing is live
port.settings.cityHint: With an empty city the location comes from your IP address (ipwho.is).
port.settings.ollamaHint: Runs on this device. Install Ollama and pull the model once: ollama pull qwen3:4b
port.settings.backupHint: The file is v-notch-settings.json in your Downloads folder. API keys are not included.
port.settings.piUrlHint: Only for the original's Raspberry Pi dashboard (home tab).
port.pi.unsupported: The port does not read the Pi dashboard yet
port.school.noMoodle: No Moodle address yet – enter it in the settings under Tabs
port.school.noToken: Not connected to Moodle – paste the calendar link in the settings under Tabs
port.settings.moodlePasteHint: Paste the token, or the whole “moodlemobile://token=…” link of the browser sign-in below.
port.settings.moodleSignInHint: The password is sent to your Moodle once to get a token and is not stored.
port.settings.moodleSaved: Signed in. The school tab reads Moodle now.
port.school.noUntisPassword: Untis: no password saved – add it in the settings under Tabs
port.settings.untisSaved: Saved. The school tab reads Untis now.
port.settings.untisHint: Server and school as in the address of your school's Untis login page; without a server the school is looked up by name. Untis has no token, so the password is kept encrypted to sign in; accounts that only sign in with Microsoft do not work.
port.settings.moodleBrowserHint: Works with the school's Microsoft login too. At the end the browser shows an error page or asks to open the Moodle app: copy the address that starts with “moodlemobile://token=” (address bar, or the developer tools F12 → Console) and paste it above.
port.settings.moodleBadToken: That is not a Moodle token or a moodlemobile:// link.
port.settings.moodleNoIcalInClipboard: The clipboard holds no Moodle calendar link (…/calendar/export_execute.php?…&authtoken=…). Select the link on the export page, press Ctrl+C and click again.
port.school.teamsSignedOut: Teams: not signed in – sign in in the settings under Tabs
port.settings.teamsCodeHint: Enter this code on {0} in your browser and sign in with your school account. Your password goes only to Microsoft, never into the notch.
port.settings.teamsSaved: Signed in. The school tab shows Teams assignments and meetings now.
port.settings.teamsHint: Needs your own app registration at entra.microsoft.com (allow public client flows). Reads your calendar and Teams assignments; only the sign-in is stored, encrypted. Where Microsoft asks for admin approval this only works once the school approves the app – Teams notifications still show as a pill.
port.settings.teamsNeedsAdmin: The school has to approve the app first (admin consent). Until then the notch shows Teams notifications from Windows as a pill.
port.bluetooth.tooFast: Too fast – wait a moment ({0} s)
port.settings.moodleIcalSaved: Saved. The school tab reads the Moodle calendar now (every 30 minutes).
port.settings.moodleBadIcal: That is not a calendar link of Moodle (…/calendar/export_execute.php?…&authtoken=…).
port.settings.moodleIcalHint: Works even where the Moodle app is blocked. On the export page choose “All” events and “Recent and next 60 days”, click “Get calendar URL”, copy the link and paste it here. It works like a password: keep it to yourself.
